obfuscation_indicators: many of which are beyond our control
risk_summary: The excerpt contains extensive boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and broad, non-quantified risk qualifications, including leverage, fixed-price contracts, government contract dependence, litigation, insurance, pension, and cybersecurity exposures. While it provides some operational and financial detail, the long enumerated disclaimer substantially limits accountability for projections and leaves the magnitude and likelihood of key risks unclear.
